messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the side. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described side upper-body camera setup and movement. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the side. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man walks slowly from left to right, swinging his arms naturally.","camera":"A medium shot at eye level tracks the man as he moves across the frame.","clothing":"A sleeveless tank top with a white, pink, and yellow tie-dye pattern, and pink shorts.","hair_color":"Platinum white.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair with a faded side.","identity":"A muscular Black man with a defined jawline and short facial hair, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor paved road or parking area bordered by a metal guardrail, with green trees, rocks, and a building in the background under a partly cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is now a closer side-profile upper-body shot of the same man, matching the reference framing at the start. The camera tracks him as he walks, and the background changes from the source's bridge/underpass view to a roadside scene with rocks, trees, a guardrail, and a building. His outfit, hair, and walking action remain broadly consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a side upper-body shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hair, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the camera movement exactly matches the intended described side upper-body movement
unexpected_changes: Background environment changed from the source's bridge/underpass setting to a different roadside scene with rocks and a building
